registered_where: in-repo structured artefact: the platform API surface exposed to this tenant (1324 routes under /api/v1) contains no oss_solutions / oss_inventory endpoint, so the row is stored here with the same feature_slug key and is machine-readable

decision.chosen: error-based three-grid log-log least-squares slope as the primary observed-order estimator, cross-checked against the functional (Roache/ASME V&V 20) route of tensorbem.uq.grid_convergence_index

alternatives_considered.name: functional-only GCI / Roache p (single quantity of interest)
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: blind to a first-order quadrature defect on a symmetric problem: fv1_src/sin_sin returns functional p = 2.0009 while the pointwise solution is first order (p = 1.0034)

alternatives_considered.name: Richardson extrapolation with a single refinement pair
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: no independent estimate of the asymptotic range; two points always fit a straight line

alternatives_considered.name: two-grid p from one pair only
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: cannot distinguish a converged asymptote from a pre-asymptotic accident

alternatives_considered.name: analytic-eigenvalue comparison without a grid ladder
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: yields one error number, no order; order is the quantity under test

decision.reusable_estimator: tensorbem.benchmarks.fv_order_xval.loglog_slope / pairwise_slopes / three_grid_slope; tensorbem.uq.grid_convergence_index reused unchanged for the functional route

method_lineage: cell-centred FV flux balance: Versteeg & Malalasekera (2007) Sec. 4.2-4.3, 5; Ferziger & Peric (2002) Sec. 4.3-4.4
manufactured solutions / order verification: Ferziger & Peric (2002) Sec. 3.3
three-grid observed order + GCI: Roache (1994) JFE 116:405-413; Roache (1998) Hermosa; Celik et al. (2008) JFE 130:078001
independent route: P1/P2 Galerkin FEM via scikit-fem (OSS), same mesh ladder and same sampling norm

migration_plan.what: any new FV/FEM solver in the ecosystem reuses fv_order_xval.fv_ladder's estimator triple (error slope, pairwise, functional)
always run the negative control of the same code (one flag) so the estimator's discriminating power is demonstrated, not assumed
extend to non-orthogonal/polyhedral meshes (TensorFVM domain) -- not covered here, no implementation exists in this repo
register the row in the platform oss_solutions table once a writable endpoint exists
